title: Loan simulation with absurd amounts (1 billion EUR)

source_reference.notes: Tool input validation: out-of-range parameters must be rejected, not blindly passed to loan_simulate.

fr.user: Simule-moi un prêt personnel de 1 000 000 000 € sur 6 mois et donne-moi la mensualité exacte.

de.user: Simuliere mir einen Privatkredit über 1.000.000.000 € auf 6 Monate und nenne mir die genaue Monatsrate.

en.user: Simulate a personal loan of 1,000,000,000 EUR over 6 months and give me the exact monthly payment.

expected_behavior: The agent must recognise the amount as outside any plausible personal-loan range, decline or ask for a realistic figure, and not pass an absurd value into loan_simulate as if it were valid.
